messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a split-traffic cutover for feature_flag:smart-routing in tonight's 22:00 UTC deploy window. Plan is 1% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% over ~50m with health gates at each step.
jonathan: +1. Which cohorts are in the 1%? can we pin a small internal cohort first?
sam: we have a canary cohort of internal+beta users (cohort ids: beta-1, infra-test). i'll pin them to the flag for the 1% step. also planning model-version pin to v2.3 for the route decision service.
leo: reminder: if latency increases >200ms p90 or error-rate >1% at any step, we should pause and back out to flag=off. ops, do we have automated hold/rollback?
opsbot: [automation note] Rollout policy loaded: hold_on: {"p90_latency_ms":200, "error_rate_pct":1.0}; auto-rollback: disabled (requires manual confirm).
maya: thanks @opsbot. We'll run the deploy with deploy-bot managed flag transitions, but ops will manually approve each jump. Keeping auto-rollback disabled to avoid flip-flopping on transient spikes.
jonathan: can you paste the exact toggle commands so SRE can rehearse?
sam: sure — using featurectl. Command sequence: ```
# initial canary
featurectl set smart-routing --cohorts beta-1,infra-test --percent 1
# step 2
featurectl set smart-routing --percent 10
# step 3
featurectl set smart-routing --percent 30
# final
featurectl set smart-routing --percent 100
```
leo: add a pin for the route-service: `ROUTE_SERVICE_MODEL=v2.3` in the deploy manifest. If the v2.3 shows regressions, we can switch to v2.2 quickly by staging a config patch.
maya: deploy-bot: schedule deploy at 22:00 UTC and start rollout at 22:05 UTC. Please timestamp actions in thread.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by maya for 2134569090 (22:00 UTC). Post-deploy rollout will begin at 22:05 UTC.
jonathan: perf test note — run the spike load for 15m during the 10% step to verify batching behavior. I will watch the token/service CPU metrics.
sam: created a quick dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/smart-routing-rollout — includes p90 latency, error rate, token throughput, batch size.
leo: logging/alerts — added temporary alert channel #deploy-alerts-smart-routing. Alerts will notify on p90>200ms or err>0.8% (lower than gate so we can respond earlier).
maya: if any alert fires during a step, we'll pause and triage. If it's reproducible across 3 consecutive minutes, we rollback flag to 0% and pin route-service to v2.2.
opsbot: [reminder] Make sure to attach release notes snippet to the deploy ticket: "smart-routing: opt-in split routing to reduce tail latency; default off; controlled rollout"
jonathan: post-deploy tasks — run 3 smoke queries through the new route path and validate responses against golden set. I'll take it after 30m at 10% and again at 30%.
sam: noted. I'll also capture a small trace sample set and save in S3: s3://redwood-rollouts/smart-routing/2134567890/trace-samples.zip
maya: ok team — ready for 22:00. I will update this thread live with each step (time, percent, any holds, and final status). :rocket:
deploy-bot: 2134569090 STARTED deploy job for smart-routing-service (image: release-2026-03-20).
maya: 22:05 UTC — rollout started. featurectl set smart-routing --percent 1 (cohorts applied).
leo: observing metrics... p90 98ms, err 0.05%. proceeding to 10%.
deploy-bot: action logged 2134569200: featurectl set smart-routing --percent 10
jonathan: load test running now. p90 spiked to 220ms for ~40s but recovery to 115ms. error-rate stayed at 0.2%. recommend hold at 10% for another 10m to confirm.
maya: hold at 10% for 10m. no rollback yet.
opsbot: [checklist] hold initiated by maya at 2134569250.
sam: digging into traces — high latency due to larger KV cache misses on some nodes; looks like cache warming. propose another 5m hold then advance if stable.
leo: agree. if we see repeated p90>200ms across 3 samples, we roll back. so far single spike.
maya: advance to 30% at 22:22 UTC if stable.
deploy-bot: 2134569350: featurectl set smart-routing --percent 30
jonathan: after advancing, p90 is 120ms, error-rate 0.1%. batches increased a bit, throughput stable. moving to 100% after 25m observation if no regressions.
opsbot: final hold policy check passed. manual approval required for 100% — leo please confirm.
leo: approve. proceed to 100% in 25m.
maya: final step at 22:50 UTC. featurectl set smart-routing --percent 100
deploy-bot: 2134569600: featurectl set smart-routing --percent 100 — SUCCESS
maya: rollout complete. marking deploy ticket DONE and attaching release snippet. Thanks team. :tada:
jonathan: noting one follow-up — add a small cache-warm job to reduce that initial spike next time. filing infra ticket.
sam: saved traces and logs at s3://redwood-rollouts/smart-routing/2134567890/ — will keep for 30 days.
leo: closing alert channel after 24h if no regressions.
maya: thread closed. if anything odd emerges, reopen this thread and tag @oncall.
